legal.privacyBody:
Last updated: 29 August 2026

Baganetic is a Bagan travel guide. This policy explains what the app stores and why.

Data stored on your device
Pagoda content, map tiles you have viewed, trip plans, favorites, and a local copy of community posts can be saved in SQLite and the map cache so the app still works offline.

Account data
If you create an account, Firebase Authentication stores your email and password hash. Your display name, profile photo, trips, favorites, and AI chat history can sync to Firestore and Firebase Storage for that account.

Community
Tips, questions, comments, and votes you publish are visible to other signed-in travelers. Do not post personal data you do not want public.

AI assistant
Signed-in AI questions are sent to our Cloud Function, then to NVIDIA's hosted model, with limited pagoda, trip, and community context. Prompts are truncated. We rate-limit usage to reduce abuse.

Maps
Map tiles come from OpenStreetMap Humanitarian tiles (with OpenStreetMap.org as fallback). Tile requests include this app's user-agent.

Location
If you allow it, the map uses GPS only while the map screen is open, to show where you are. Location is not uploaded to our servers.

Your choices
You can use guest mode without an account. Signed-in users can delete their account from Profile. That removes the Firebase user, synced profile data, and your community posts when the server function is deployed.

Contact
Questions: admin@baganetic.com
legal.termsBody:
Last updated: 29 August 2026

By using Baganetic you agree to these terms.

The app is a travel aid, not official heritage or government guidance. Always follow local rules at pagodas and check conditions on the ground. Routes are planned from a curated offline graph and may omit roads, closures, or ferry changes.

Community posts are user-generated and unverified. Do not post illegal, harmful, or misleading content. We may remove content or accounts that abuse the service.

The AI assistant can be wrong. Treat replies as suggestions, not facts.

You must be old enough to use email/password accounts under the laws of your country. You are responsible for keeping your password private.

The app is provided as-is, without warranty that routing, opening hours, or fees are complete. To the extent allowed by law we are not liable for travel decisions made with the app.

OpenStreetMap data is © OpenStreetMap contributors and available under the ODbL. Humanitarian map tiles are provided by HOT.

We may update these terms in a later app version.
